idea-plugin.name: Ask Claude
idea-plugin.description: Select code, press the shortcut, type a question in a small popup, and send it to the Claude Code session running in the IDE's Terminal tool window, together with a file and line-range reference (@src/Foo.kt#L10-20). The message is submitted and the editor keeps focus. Requires Claude Code to be installed and running in the Terminal tool window.

action.description: Ask Claude Code about the selected lines and send it to the running session
